scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/tool-definitions.v1.json dist/tool-definitions.v1.json && cp src/runtime-manifest.v1.json dist/runtime-manifest.v1.json
scripts.manual: pi --provider openai-codex --model gpt-5.6-luna --thinking medium --no-builtin-tools --no-extensions --extension ./src/manual-code-policy-extension.ts --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-context-files --tools python_exec --no-session --system-prompt "You control a robot in a simulated environment. Complete the user's task through python_exec. Its persistent Python session preloads app for deployed DimOS RPCs and memory for observations. Inspect available interfaces when needed, use closed-loop behavior, stop the robot when the task is complete, and report what you observed."
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/tool-definitions.v1.json dist/tool-definitions.v1.json && cp src/runtime-manifest.v1.json dist/runtime-manifest.v1.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cp src/tool-definitions.v1.json dist-test/src/tool-definitions.v1.json && cp src/runtime-manifest.v1.json dist-test/src/runtime-manifest.v1.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
